fieldNotes.locating: Roster coords (40.094265, -93.603911) and the roster's stated address (1011 Industrial Rd) are both wrong/unconfirmed; the roster itself flags the street as approximate. The plant's real address is 1401 Harris Ave, Trenton MO (per Waze/Manta/LoopNet, APN 110516030601100). The correct building was found ~1.5 km SW of the roster point and positively confirmed by a Street View showing a 'Nestlé PROFESSIONAL - Making MORE Possible' employee-entrance sign on the building's east face. Locked center 40.08080, -93.61050.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate identified. The plant is an older urban-fabric food plant; the SW/S truck yard reads as open paved area continuous with the adjacent street, with tractors and trailers parked freely. Chain-link fencing exists along parts of the perimeter (W and S) but the truck yard entrance shows no barrier arm or pinch-point in 2023 Street View. Classified false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any truck entrance. A small structure existed near the SW in older (2008) imagery but does not read as a staffed guard booth on the truck lane. False.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Modest dock count for a canning plant. Dock doors with trailers backed in observed on the W and SW faces; ~10-20 doors estimated, banded 10-25. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop yard on the NE corner holding ~15-20 parked trailers in rows; banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail yard with multiple tracks runs immediately along the W boundary of the plant; rail siding serves the plant - railServed true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Trenton is a small NW-Missouri town (~6,000 population). The plant is surrounded by residential houses on several sides but the broad setting is small-town/rural; per rubric tie-break, Rural.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach from street to docks; truck yard is compact.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~360m N-S x ~400m E-W including the E employee lot) ~ 12 acres for the fenced/operational footprint.
